document.scope: Corrected pre-registration resolving all 36 issues (U1-U36) and all seven blocking findings (A1-A7) of the independent audit. No simulation, recording, training or instrumentation was performed or implemented.

non_claims: Mutual information does not establish causation.
A decoder label does not establish a motor command.
A simulated spike is not a biological spike.
A positive propagation pilot does not establish that the fly behaves the same way.
A structural edge does not establish functional transmission.
Direct first-hop injection is a capability control, not evidence of natural sensory propagation.
No Stage R result can be promoted above evidence grade E1-E2.

A1.defect: d* fixed at P1; P2 read only at d*
A1.correction: P1a, P1, P2a, P2b read at all four drives from the same 964 runs; d* is the lowest drive at which all four pass, frozen before any downstream outcome

A2.defect: P2 conflates first and second hop and used a zero-tolerance control rule
A2.correction: Split into P2a (H2), P2b (DESC2, 9 first-hop DNs excluded), P2c (charge form), P2s (feature specificity); presence gates are screens with stated effect-size floors and a sensitivity curve

A3.defect: 2,688 unique seeds contradicts the paired design
A3.correction: 672 unique noise seeds, 2,688 condition-runs, 672 trials per condition, paired by seed

A4.defect: 43 distinct events are 43 records from 24 tracks
A4.correction: 24 distinct (class, track) pairs; track-level resampling; OBST_NEAR not estimable

A5.defect: Stage S 0.05-bit criterion below the 40-cluster MDE
A5.correction: 134 independent substrate clusters; MDE 0.0498 bits at alpha 0.005; proxy SD declared with a realized-MDE fallback

A6.defect: O2 samples post-step _V, which is -68 mV for a spiking neuron
A6.correction: Threshold substitution or pre-reset sampling, spiked flag, copy-on-record, zero RNG consumption, one recorder, install/restore, declared time base; T1-T12

A7.defect: Archived event times cannot occur inside a 300 ms trial
A7.correction: Declared event-time transform: trial_time_ms = 50.0, decay_ms = 100.0, original archive time retained in field 11

stimulus_corpus.cross_level_explanation: Five train tracks cross the 0.653686 median; jump-roll-barrier track 11 spans both obstacle halves. The union is 24.

event_time_transform.rule: archive_time_ms -> trial_time_ms = 50.0 for every selected event

stimulus_corpus.allocation: round-robin over the level's distinct tracks, then over the track's records

trial.time_base: spike at (step_index + 1) * 0.5 ms; bin and window edges lower-inclusive

gates.name: integrity
gates.pass: all 964 records complete every mandatory field (<= 0.5% exclusion per arm); 5% re-run reproduces spike_hash; archived 4H condition B and C hashes reproduced; no SpikeCapacityExceeded; all recorded potential arrays finite
gates.fail: any unexplained determinism mismatch or silent truncation, or > 0.5% exclusion in any arm

gates.name: STIM activation
gates.pass: at some drive REAL STIM prevalence >= 20/40 and one-sided Fisher p < 0.0125 vs NO_STIM
gates.fail: no drive activates STIM while DIRECT_INJECTION at >= 400 pA drives H1: drive/encoder failure; both silent: model-regime limit
gates.inconclusive: effect carried by one seed half with opposite sign in the other

gates.name: first-hop propagation
gates.pass: at some drive REAL H1 prevalence >= 10/40 and Fisher p < 0.0125 vs NO_STIM
gates.inconclusive: test passes but effect-size floor not met

gates.name: second-hop propagation (screen)
gates.pass: at some drive REAL H2 prevalence >= 6/40 and REAL - NO_STIM >= 4/40
gates.fail: no drive passes: stop; report no second-hop propagation detected under this design

gates.name: descending beyond first hop (screen)
gates.pass: at some drive REAL DESC2 prevalence >= 2/40 and REAL - NO_STIM >= 2/40
gates.fail: no drive passes: H3/H4 untestable; not a stop if P2a passed
gates.inconclusive: all DESC spikes in the nine H1D neurons

gates.name: charge form
gates.pass: REAL > PEAK_MATCHED_RECT on H2 union DESC2 prevalence, paired by seed, one-sided p < 0.025
gates.fail: propagation is charge-driven; the pattern-specificity claim is withdrawn

gates.name: feature specificity
gates.pass: REAL > SHUFFLED_MASK on H2 union DESC2 prevalence, paired by seed, one-sided p < 0.025
gates.fail: propagation is not feature-specific; H2/H3 descriptive

gates.name: decoder reachability
gates.pass: >= 1 post-stimulus REAL window non-NEUTRAL and every NO_STIM and PEAK_MATCHED_RECT window NEUTRAL
gates.fail: no REAL window non-NEUTRAL: H5 untestable; H1-H4 proceed
gates.inconclusive: REAL and a control both non-NEUTRAL: decoder endpoints leave the confirmatory family

gates.name: motor recruitment
gates.pass: >= 1 REAL trial has >= 1 MOT spike and no NO_STIM trial does
gates.fail: no MOT spike in any REAL trial: H4 untestable

d_star_rule.definition: lowest drive at which P1a, P1, P2a and P2b all pass
d_star_rule.freeze_point: after presence gates at all four drives, before P2c, P2s, P3, P3a and before any Stage R outcome
d_star_rule.evidence: gate-decision file written and SHA-256'd at G4

conditions.role: capability control only; in no gate or endpoint
per-spike calibration only; in no gate or endpoint
bijective payload permutation across the 43 records

stage_r.pairing: seed reused across R1-R4; RANDOM_MAPPING paired on 40 of the same seeds
stage_r.shuffled_mask_behaviour: shuffle_feature_identities permutes payloads across events, preserving timestamps; the mapping is not permuted; per-trial injected charge is recorded and used as a covariate in E4/E5

stage_s.substrate: Phase 5 task graph, TaskConfig(n_cues=4, cue_neurons=8, action_neurons=1), 36 nodes
stage_s.phase_5f_direction: plastic success minus fixed success positive

stages.gate: P0, P1a, P1, P2a, P2b, P2c, P2s, P3, P3a
Stage S integrity and Phase 5F direction

hypotheses.level: sensory input to stimulated sensory neurons

response.name: R_STIM
response.definition: recruitment code of STIM in [50,300) ms

hypotheses.null: I(S; R_STIM) = 0; REAL prevalence equals NO_STIM
hypotheses.criterion: corrected MI above its own permutation q95, track-cluster CI excluding zero, >= 2 observed levels

hypotheses.null: I(R_STIM; R_H1) = 0; REAL H1 prevalence equals NO_STIM
hypotheses.criterion: information criterion and presence gate P1

hypotheses.level: downstream activity beyond the first hop
stages: P gates P2a P2b P2c P2s
hypotheses.null: I(S; R_H2DESC) = 0; REAL prevalence equals NO_STIM
hypotheses.criterion: P2a and P2b presence, P2c and P2s specificity, E5/E6 above their permutation nulls

predictor.name: descending spiking in the same trial

hypotheses.bias_floor_note: the confirmatory statistic is a paired proportion; no bias floor applies
hypotheses.null: paired proportion difference between REAL and NO_STIM is zero
hypotheses.criterion: P3a passed and the paired difference excludes zero

response.name: A
response.definition: last non-NEUTRAL decoder state in [50,300) ms, else NEUTRAL; one value per trial

hypotheses.criterion: correctly labelled estimate only; never a motor-control or biological claim
controls: decoder ablation with seeded pool permutation

hypotheses.level: neural code under fixed versus plastic weights

response.name: A_neural
response.definition: argmax evaluation spike count over four action neurons, fifth level for none, ties to the lowest index

hypotheses.null: I(CUE; A_neural) is equal in fixed_complete and plastic_complete
hypotheses.criterion: paired cluster-level difference exceeds the realized MDE and its interval excludes zero

endpoints.estimand: proportion of trials with >= 1 STIM spike
median STIM spike count per trial
proportion of trials with >= 1 H1 spike

endpoints.test: corrected MI vs permutation q95; track bootstrap; paired condition permutation

sample_size.derivation: lcm(16,24) = 48; smallest multiple of 48 >= 648 is 672 = 48 x 14
sample_size.realized_mde_rule: if the observed between-substrate SD at 134 clusters implies an MDE above 0.05 bits, E10 is demoted to exploratory before its result is examined

memory.concurrency: one process; concurrency only if > 1.5 GiB free, at most two workers

schema.field_count_note: Row 12 carries stimulus_onset_ms and stimulus_offset_ms; row 21 carries reward and prediction_error. panel_node_ids is optional.

instrumentation_contract.threshold_rule: substitute threshold_mv for returned spike indices, or sample the potential before the -68 mV reset; record a spiked flag; never record -68 mV as the spike value
instrumentation_contract.copy_rule: copy every retained array; _V, _exc, _inh and last_active_edges are mutated in place
instrumentation_contract.install_rule: install and restore in try/finally; a second install is a loud error
instrumentation_contract.recorder_rule: one recorder; BancSimulator.run already calls recorder.record
instrumentation_contract.callback_rule: the Stage S callback returns None, otherwise it replaces the reward
instrumentation_contract.time_base_rule: spikes at (step+1) x 0.5 ms; edges lower-inclusive
